260: fn had_reset(args: &[String]) -> bool {
261:     // Indices where "--binary" or "-b", "--tag", and "--untagged" are found
262:     let binary_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--binary" || x == "-b");
263:     let tag_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--tag");
264:     let untagged_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--untagged");
265: 
266:     // Check if all arguments are present and in the correct order
267:     match (binary_index, tag_index, untagged_index) {
268:         (Some(b), Some(t), Some(u)) => b < t && t < u,
269:         _ => false,
